<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex7052023-07-1814-08-32" status="reviewed"> <milestone unit="section" n="v. 2"/>
        <lg> <l>brtse chen blo gros ldan ba lta ngan sgra gcan las grol zhing || </l>
         <l>chos kyi snang pa mchog gis blo ngan rab rib rnams bsal te ||</l>
         <l>sa stengs 'di na nyi bzhin grags pa lham me snang gyur pa ||</l><l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3805">zla myed <choice><corr>rigs par smra ba</corr><sic>rigs pas smra ba</sic></choice> chos gyi bla ma</rs> dpal <choice><reg>la</reg><orig>‹la›</orig></choice> 'dud ||</l></lg>
      <note type="translation">I bow down to the auspicious (Zhang tshe spong) Chos kyi bla ma, the matchless logician who, having great compassion and intelligence, is freed from the eclipse maker (Rāhu) of wrong views, and who eliminates eye-diseases (timira) of the bad-minded people by means of excellent light of teaching, and briliantly shining forth on the earth with a sun-like glory.</note></seg></TEI>
